source_statements.source_statement: Execute the attached Universal Service Provider Studio prompt in goal mode.
Audit and reuse the canonical implementation first.
Work only in a clean isolated worktree.
Integrate and merge into the repository's actual default branch only after every required gate passes.

Read and reconcile the actual repository first, including canonical source of truth, provider routes, Content/Research, prompt UI/storage, AI adapters, Remotion tooling, usage implementation, migrations, tests, and PR #5.
Implement a reusable Studio module for every service_provider workspace, separate from Content/Library.
Studio must preserve immutable pasted source text and support structured brief, audience, format, tone, and output definition.
Add domain models for Studio projects, sources, briefs, characters, guardrails, scenes, prompt layers, assets, exports, jobs, and usage.
Every Studio query and write must validate authenticated actor, workspace membership, role/capability, project ownership/scope, and requested action.
Implement a deterministic layered prompt compiler with versioning, visible compiled/diff/history views, schema-validated outputs, and prompt-injection defense.
Natural-language corrections must become previewable structured patches scoped to scene, character, project, or future workspace defaults.
Implement a lightweight structured slideshow/video editor with scene ordering, timing, text styling, assets, transitions, narration, preview, render, and mobile/tablet responsive behavior.
Background generation and render jobs must be reliable, observable, retryable, idempotent, and testable without live vendor credentials.
Every AI/vendor call is metered by workspace, provider, user, model, operation, tokens/media units, latency, status, and estimated cost, with provider and Super Admin visibility.
Approved Studio outputs can be handed off into the existing Content/Library workflow without automatic publication.
Rabbi Eli Scheller / One Time is the first configured pilot, but One Time behavior must be provider-configurable and not hard-coded into shared layers.

Run focused tests, full tests, execution-run validation, watchdogs, secret audit, diff hygiene, migration repeat tests, Chromium/WebKit browser tests, independent verification, and final documentation.
